Description

Hit the slopes in style with the Men's Paramount Synthetic Jacket. Packed with Primaloft insulation for ultimate warmth, it boasts concealed chest pockets and side hand pockets for all your essentials. Gusseted underarms ensure maximum mobility, and the removeable powder skirt keeps the snow out so you can focus on the thrill of the ride. Get ready to conquer the mountain in comfort and flair! 

Features

  • Matte Microtex shell with a slight stretch
  • 8000 water column rating with 8000 g/m²/24hr breathability rating
  • Body-mapped insulation to effectively regulate your temperature and retain heat
  • 130g/m² Primaloft Silver insulation on front back, back and outer arms
  • 100g/m² Primaloft Silver insulation on underarms, centre spine and hood
  • PFC-Free DWR coating aids with water repellency
  • Adjustable helmet-compatible fixed hood with elastic binding for a snug fit
  • Two concealed zip chest pockets for extra storage
  • Concealed side-zip pockets for warmth
  • Internal zippered chest pocket for your valuables
  • Ski pass zip pocket on the LHS sleeve
  • Adjustable hem cord on both sides
  • Internal elasticated dump pockets
  • Gusseted underarms for comfort and easy movement
  • Integrated stretch-knit cuffs with adjustable velcro tabs to seal in warmth
  • Removeable powder skirt, attached with zip

Specifications

  • Waterhead: 8000mm
  • Breathability: 8000 g/m²/24 h
